whether DW revokes the old wallet unit at once (client_status = 1 , cascade in Revoke-Suspend-Reactivate CASE C) is decided by the DW team
another device of the same user is a separate wallet unit and is not revoked

other channels : the schema belongs to the caller's organisation

Use the ACTIVE key of that DID , set by the agency in setup (Keys.Status = ACTIVE , Keys.IdentityId)

(credential_types is a proposal only) and no field for the credential_issuer URL , the credential type check waits for the Thai profile

the switch changes only Keys.Status , no engine call , the next issuance sends the new key as issuerKey
Switch issuerKey to the next reserved key in the DID
[No reserved key left in the DID]

Use ClaimId from the request as the engine claim id
(CredentialSchemas.Claims[].ClaimId is the claim id created by the engine)
[ENGINE RULE] the credential is created unsigned (state CREATED) , no status list index yet
the engine signs it when the wallet requests the credential (part 2 , VCVP Core 16)
credentialSchemaId = ENGINE_CREDENTIAL_SCHEMA_ID , issuer = ENGINE_ISSUER_IDENTIFIER_ID , issuerKey = ENGINE_ISSUER_KEY_ID
CredentialSchemaId , IssuerOrganizationId , IssuerIdentityId , IssuerKeyId , CitizenHashId (hash of CitizenId , cannot be turned back , the raw CitizenId is not stored) , SyncDate
[DATA STORE] Store credential in Credentials table
• appendix 8.1 D.2 (proposal) tx_code recommended for IAL2.1 - 2.2
[CONDITION] When this runs : only for credential types with RequiredLoA IAL2.1 or higher
their schema is created with transactionCode (NUMERIC , 6 digits) , IAL1 types have no transactionCode and skip the tx_code steps
the user must enter the code before the pre-authorized_code expires (300 seconds) , otherwise the offer is renewed with a new code
[AUDIT LOG] Write audit record of VCVP Core 08 : which credential was issued , to whom , by which issuer key (TrustCheck , EngineCalls , Correlation.CredentialId)
200 | CredentialId , OfferUrl = null , IssuerTrust (Result , CheckedAt , RegistryReference)
Check Consumer-Key (DW Core central Consumer-Key) , caller channel = WALLET , ActorType = CITIZEN
url , expiresAt , transactionCode (only when the schema has transactionCode)
[DATA STORE] Store offer in Credentials table
[AUDIT LOG] Write audit record of VCVP Core 09 : when the offer link was created for the credential (EngineCalls , Correlation.CredentialId)
200 | CredentialId + OfferUrl + ExpiresAt + TransactionCode (only when the schema has transactionCode)
[ENGINE RULE] schema transactionCode = { type NUMERIC or ALPHANUMERIC , length 4 to 10 , description }
share returns transactionCode only for such a schema , every share returns a new code
expiresAt , transactionCode (only when the schema has transactionCode)
transactionCode goes only into the response to DW Core , it is not logged and not stored
[DATA STORE] Store offer in Credentials table
[AUDIT LOG] Write audit record of VCVP Core 08 : which credential was issued , to whom , by which issuer key (TrustCheck , EngineCalls , Correlation.CredentialId)
200 | CredentialId + OfferUrl + ExpiresAt + IssuerTrust (Result , CheckedAt , RegistryReference) + TransactionCode (only when the schema has transactionCode)
[ENGINE RULE] no webhook when an offer expires | INTERACTION_EXPIRED only after the task INTERACTION_EXPIRATION_CHECK runs
[SPEC] scheduled job : PENDING and OfferExpiresAt passed , engine PENDING or INTERACTION_EXPIRED -> OFFER_EXPIRED , engine OFFERED -> keep PENDING
a renewed offer sets PENDING again | credential_accepted later still sets ACTIVE
[DATA STORE] Store CredentialId + OfferUrl + ExpiresAt + IssuerTrust in DW database (issuance request)
DW Core resolves the offer next (part 2 section 7) and then answers request 1.2
[Response has TransactionCode (credential type with RequiredLoA IAL2.1 or higher)]
[PENDING] DW team decides the delivery channels (SMS , e-mail , other) , where the verified contact comes from ,
and what happens when the user has no verified contact | OpenID4VCI 1.0 3.5 : the code goes by a channel other than the offer
Send tx_code by SMS or e-mail to the verified contact of the user (second channel)
the code is not logged and not stored after it is sent
